events.body:
## Context

`public/js/config.js` has `PROJECT_PATH: "owasp-blt/blt-pages"` (GitLab era) and `ISSUE_TEMPLATE`, which nothing reads. `@fontsource/manrope` in package.json isn't used (fonts are vendored). `playwright.config.js` runs `python` instead of `python3`.

## What to do

1. Delete the dead keys, remove the dependency (update package-lock.json), and use `python3` in the webServer command.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] No unused config keys
- [ ] `npm ci && npm test` still works
- [ ] Unit tests pass

## How to test locally

```bash
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-pages
```

---
